svg.title: Rustic engine completion: 27.94%
svg.desc: Weighted engine completion is 27.94%: 21.25% from capabilities verified complete and 6.69% partial credit from verified steps of in-progress capabilities. A scope map sizes every subsystem by its engine weight, milestone bars follow the roadmap, and each subsystem row shows capability cells sized by relative scope. Green is verified complete, blue is verified partial progress, gray is remaining.
